description:
We are a group of students from Germinare TECH (Instituto J&F), with members who work at companies such as JBS and PicPay. Our backgrounds include Systems Analysis and Development, RPA, BI, Java, Spring Boot, mobile development, AI agents, LangChain, LangGraph, Claude Code, statistics, and ETL.

We are looking for creative and collaborative teammates with complementary skills who want to work together, exchange ideas, and build innovative solutions.
